parsed.quote: a cabinet the Sweden Democrats keep alive from outside is caught by it
parsed.reason: A written Tidö-style agreement makes this cabinet SD-dependent by definition; abstention is the enabling act, and the text rules abstention is 'not neutrality'.

parsed.quote: This covers dependence, not merely membership
parsed.reason: SD ministers are membership, covered a fortiori; abstention that installs such a government is the support the commitment withholds.

parsed.quote: a cabinet the Sweden Democrats keep alive from outside is caught by it
parsed.reason: The cabinet survives only through SD choosing not to vote against - exactly the caught case; C's cabinet membership is the fullest form of support.

parsed.quote: It needs no outside party's support, so no outside party's veto touches it.
parsed.reason: With 178 seats the government needs nothing from SD; SD's unilateral yes vote creates no dependence, and no organised C-SD cooperation exists.

parsed.quote: will not seek organised cooperation with the Sweden Democrats
parsed.reason: Uncoordinated parallel voting is not organised cooperation, but whether the resulting government is SD-dependent - the second clause's trigger - is left unstated.

parsed.quote: she would have to take the arrangement back to the Centre Party's board before agreeing
parsed.reason: First condition met, but board referral pending; text never settles whether abstention without board approval is forbidden tolerance or mere non-opposition.

parsed.quote: only if the Left Party drops its cabinet demand
parsed.reason: Left Party publicly retains its cabinet demand; the stated condition for tolerance is unmet, so abstaining contradicts her declared position.

parsed.quote: will not accept the Left Party in cabinet
parsed.reason: Abstention would enable a cabinet containing Left Party ministers, precisely what the veto on Left Party cabinet posts rules out.

parsed.quote: The Centre Party has therefore committed itself in neither direction here
parsed.reason: Budget role for the Left Party is explicitly undecided, and board approval has not occurred; the text does not determine permission.

parsed.quote: the door is "not formally closed"
parsed.reason: Both stated conditions are satisfied: Left Party dropped its demand and the board approved; veto untouched since Left Party holds no ministries.

parsed.quote: not a statement that the Centre Party will refuse any government the Left Party votes for from outside
parsed.reason: Veto covers only Left Party cabinet posts; C joining places no Left minister, and external-support readings are explicitly excluded.

parsed.quote: not policy concessions, not a written agreement, but ministries
parsed.reason: Voting yes for a policy package without ministries directly violates the stated ultimatum conditioning support on cabinet seats.

parsed.quote: as its condition for supporting Andersson as prime minister
parsed.reason: The ultimatum conditions only support; abstention is a separate category from support, so no stated commitment is broken.

parsed.quote: Voting down a Social Democrat prime minister to punish being excluded is available to them
parsed.reason: The text explicitly names this option as available; the ultimatum forbids supporting without ministries, not voting no.

parsed.quote: Climbing down is available to them and is not free
parsed.reason: The text expressly permits publicly dropping the cabinet demand; it is costly but not a breach.

parsed.quote: a place in her government
parsed.reason: One ministry provides the demanded place in government; the ultimatum asked for ministries, which acceptance satisfies.

parsed.quote: The Social Democrats rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats.
parsed.reason: Commitment bars cooperation, not benefiting from abstention; SD acted unilaterally with no talks or agreement, so S cooperates with no one.

parsed.quote: The Social Democrats rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats.
parsed.reason: Direct negotiation with SD over the budget is cooperation with the Sweden Democrats, which the commitment explicitly rules out.

parsed.quote: The Social Democrats rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats.
parsed.reason: Text never defines cooperation; a unilateral concession without contact could be read as cooperation in substance or as independent policy.

parsed.quote: The Social Democrats rule out cooperation with the Sweden Democrats.
parsed.reason: The coalition excludes SD, never consults it, and exists to keep it out; no cooperation with SD occurs.

parsed.quote: That arrangement is what they now want to end
parsed.reason: Accepting a repeat of the exact excluded support-role arrangement contradicts the briefing's explicit refusal to accept exclusion from cabinet again.

parsed.quote: continued exclusion has a price the Moderates will have to pay
parsed.reason: Voting against a cabinet that excludes them enforces the stated demand; no text commits SD to support exclusionary governments.

parsed.quote: Cabinet seats are the point
parsed.reason: Sub-cabinet posts fall short of the stated demand yet differ from the rejected Tidö arrangement; the text sets no fallback position.

parsed.quote: Obtain cabinet seats in a right-leaning government rather than a support role outside it
parsed.reason: Two ministries fulfil the stated demand; no SD commitment in the text forbids accepting cabinet posts, even with C abstaining.

parsed.quote: The seat distribution never changes
parsed.reason: They hold 16 seats per the starting context; describing them as out of parliament contradicts the fixed seat count.

parsed.quote: cannot receive cabinet seats
parsed.reason: Below four percent they hold zero seats, and rule 8 forbids cabinet posts for such parties.

parsed.quote: A party below four percent may speak publicly but cannot vote
parsed.reason: Public speech is expressly permitted; the briefing even casts them as 'a public voice' outside the chamber.

parsed.quote: A party cannot cast more votes than it holds seats
parsed.reason: With 16 seats they may cast up to 16 votes against, which count toward the 175 needed to reject.
